Hello,

```toml
a.b.c = "d"
a.b.e = "f"
```

```python
import tomlkit

print(tomlkit.__version__)
# 0.13.3

a = tomlkit.parse("""
a.b.c = "d"
a.b.e = "f"
""")
assert a == {"a": {"b": {"c": "d", "e": "f"}}}  # ok
value = a["a"]
expected = {"b": {"c": "d", "e": "f"}}
assert value == expected  # ok

print(value)
# {'b': {'e': 'f'}}
print(expected)
# {'b': {'c': 'd', 'e': 'f'}}

assert repr(value) == repr(expected)

#     assert repr(value) == repr(expected)
#            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
# AssertionError
```

As far as I can tell, this doesn't happen on a, only on `a["a"]`.
I've tried to simplify the issue as much as possible.

The test file will be saved as tests/test_reprobot_tomlkit__439.py.
